{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
df_clean = df.drop(qa_orders.index)

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the final dataset
df_final.shape"}
